observation.visible_scene: A whole raw fish (pinkish-white flesh, eye visible at right) lies diagonally on black metal grill bars over glowing orange-yellow flames. A yellow lemon slice is tucked into a slit along the fish's belly, and a sprig of fine green herb protrudes from its open mouth/cavity near the head. A second, out-of-focus fish with a lemon wedge sits in the upper background. Two round green limes rest on the grate at the left.
visible_changes: The camera slowly pans/trucks leftward across the scene: the foreground fish and the background fish drift rightward within the frame, and the fish's head eventually exits the right edge while its tail becomes more fully shown at left.
As the view shifts left, the green limes (initially absent or a thin edge) progressively enter and become fully visible, joined by a yellow lemon wedge at the far-left edge by the end.
The flames beneath the grate flicker and change shape continuously throughout the segment.
The fish itself, the inserted lemon slice, and the herb remain stationary and undeformed relative to the grill bars; no flipping, sliding, or visible cooking change occurs.
outside_clip_unknowns: What lies beyond the left edge before the limes appear, and beyond the right edge after the head leaves the frame.
Whether the pan continues, reverses, or stops after this segment, and whether the fish is later flipped or removed.
The actual heat-cooking outcome of the fish, since no browning or texture change is visible within the excerpt.
uncertain_details: The apparent motion of the fish and limes is camera movement, not object motion; the limes do not translate, they are merely revealed.
The herb's exact species (dill-like) and the background fish's precise position are not fully resolvable.
The camera path (handheld vs. mounted) cannot be determined from the frames alone.
